english.title: Operator of aircraft without manual fail to supply required data and instructions to pilot and retain it after flight
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the operator of an aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), for which neither an operations manual nor a police operations manual was required by the Air Navigation Order 2016 failed

(A)_[before the commencement of a flight, namely **(..SPECIFY FLIGHT..), to cause to be supplied in writing to the pilot in command of the aircraft the required data and instructions]_
(B)_[to cause a copy of the required data and instructions to be retained on the ground for at least three months after a flight, namely **(..SPECIFY FLIGHT..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 131(6) and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016
